section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: The ConvertSprite module provides a proxy conversion for the ImageFileRender routines to the ImageFileConvert module. This means that the renderers provided by ImageFileRender can be used as sources for a conversion to sprite. For example, the Artworks ImageFileRender is proxied by the ConvertSprite module so that an Artworks to Sprite conversion is possible.
In addition, the ConvertSprite module provides a means by which sprites can be created from an arbitrary rendering routine, in a similar manner to that used by the DragAnObject module.

swi-definition.name: ConvertSprite_CreateSprite
swi-definition.description: Create a sprite from an arbitrary rendering routine

entry.register-use: Mode to use, or -1 for current
Pointer to palette, or -1 for none, or unused for deep modes
Pointer to sprite buffer, or 0 to read buffer size
Pointer to 10 register block to pass to SWI

exit.register-use: Size of sprite buffer needed (if R5=0 on entry), size of sprite buffer used (if R5<>0 on entry)

use.p: This SWI is used to create a sprite of a given type using any arbitrary rendering routine. This allows clients to convert images which would usually be rendered to the screen to sprites.
